function: Heterodimeric electron transfer flavoprotein that accepts electrons from dehydrogenases. It transfers the electrons to the main respiratory chain via ETF-ubiquinone oxidoreductase (ETF dehydrogenase). EtfB binds an AMP molecule that probably has a purely structural role.
